acceptanceCriteria: Canonical state includes test case, test suite, and test run records.
Test records can link directly to acceptance criteria.
Requirement traceability can be derived through Requirement -> Epic AC -> Test links.
Canonical diagnostics can identify tests that reference missing requirements, ACs, or work records.
notes: Implementation: Added canonical test, test suite, and test run records with test kind/status enums; canonical JSON persistence under state/tests, state/test-suites, and state/test-runs; repository load-state support; and requirement trace summaries that include test IDs.

Traceability: Tests can link directly to requirements or through acceptance criteria, and generated requirement specifications include a Tests column while the human-facing RTM remains limited to Requirements -> Epic ACs.
Diagnostics: Canonical validation reports tests, suites, and runs that reference missing requirements, acceptance criteria, tests, suites, or work records.

Evidence: swift test --package-path AirframeCore passed on 2026-07-06. swift test --package-path AICockpit passed on 2026-07-06. xcodebuild test -project AgileCockpit/AgileCockpit.xcodeproj -scheme AgileCockpit -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:AgileCockpitTests passed on 2026-07-06.
rationale: Tests need first-class canonical records so they can verify acceptance criteria and provide requirement traceability without overloading evidence summaries or task records.
testSteps: Run AirframeCore tests covering test record encoding, decoding, validation, and trace queries.
